summary: Reusable opaque artifact hashing/storage, bounded evidence-file hash/path checks, and the existing Part-render query are present. No inspected source is a drop-in admission/display consumer of the saved Lab14 complete finite JSON-safe ranked candidateSet; generic ledger rendering is lossy for nested groups/rows/raw/factors. A Lab15-only adapter/probe would be new bounded consumer work, not a producer/geometry change.

remote_refresh.method: connected GitHub branch GETs plus ordinary read-only git ls-remote; no fetch/clone/checkout
remote_refresh.qualification: These are refreshed observed heads, not claims that owners are inactive. Old otherowner local path was not probed or adopted.

findings.detail: candidateSet is a declared ArtifactKind. Memory sink hashes exact bytes and stores refs/blobs; Node sink writes bytes. These do not parse/admit payload schema, validate complete scored rows, or render saved candidateSet semantics.

resolveEvidencePath keeps paths lexically within forkRoot; validatedEvidence checks supplied SHA256 and JSON.parse; named downstream S5/S6 schema/source/snapshot branches then select data. This is source-backed existing evidence admission routing, but it is tied to named nctk files and is not a Lab14 candidateSet consumer. Lexical path confinement is not claimed symlink-safe or sufficient hostile-input security.

findings.source: remote alg fg/render.mjs:22-24,48-81; remote Claude fg/render.mjs:29-31,59-110
findings.detail: Both generic rows ledgers retain scalarFields only. A Lab14 envelope falls through object -> groups array -> rows ledger, whose per-group scalar fields retain badgeId but omit nested rows. Rendering individual scored rows similarly omits nested raw/factors. This is static source reasoning, not executed testimony.

createPartStore registers fn.q.part.render, rendering store.get(args.a) through renderValue; an image-free store can render without coordinates. This is a reusable existing seam, not permission to invoke or adopt current-owner code.

findings.source: remote Claude fg/canon.mjs canonicalJson/plain/digest and fg/node-sink.mjs
findings.detail: canonicalJson sorts object keys, refuses Map/Set, normalizes typed arrays and filters undefined keys; the file sink hashes exact supplied bytes and refuses overwrites. Re-serializing parsed Lab14 JSON with canonicalJson need not preserve original artifact SHA. Admission should preserve and verify captured original bytes before any presentation-derived copy.

Current platform owner owns fg/**, scripts/**, docs/agents/** and ui/**. Algorithm owner owns separate impl/port paths. Requests across lanes are notes to owner/Sam, not edits. Lab15 should remain isolated in Lab experiments and not silently change those current routing/render sources.

nonduplication_qualifications: No clone, fetch, checkout, branch adoption, Git/source mutation, producer execution, geometry math execution, CV/pixel/image access, tests, rendering, or subagents.
Tree/path inventory and selected source reads are scoped evidence only; no global absence claim across all branches/files, uncommitted owner work, services, or unavailable former local paths.
Default-branch connected code search for candidateSet returned no indexed matches; this is not proof of absence. Guessed legacy renderer paths returned 404 and were not treated as absence.
All observations are static source evidence; no runtime compatibility, independent capture, fixture admission result, visual result, physical truth, or production/deployment claim.
Saved candidateSet is evidence-only. It must not be re-derived into current live pipeline Parts contrary to current-owner AGENTS guidance without explicit owner/human direction.

Any future scoped proposal must preserve existing ranking and all rows/order/raw/factors; do not implement a duplicate ranker, choose winners, infer physical ownership, or mutate current platform source.
next_probe_qualification: Only if separately approved: a Lab15-local opt-in consumer can accept a saved artifact reference plus original bytes, check the exact Lab14 artifact identity/kind/schema and complete finite JSON-safe row contract, then retain complete nested evidence for a faithful non-geometry view. Reuse low-level hashing/admission patterns by evidence, not branch adoption. The exact admission policy still needs root selection.
